scope: Dataset preparation and retrieval evaluation for the existing FAME-AX research architecture. Does not claim a completed full learned FAME-AX model or validated causal effects.

single_query_dense.score: equal mean of separate Problem/Task/Context cosine scores

multi_perspective.perspective_count: dynamic 2 to 5 under inherited RQ1 v1.3 experimental constraint
multi_perspective.output_budget: same total distinct case budget K as single-query comparator

gpt_only.input: query plus all candidate Problem/Task/Context fields

existing_learned_comparators.status: historical Dev reference; any new final training must use only Dev labels and pin artifacts before Test inference

reference_relevance_scale.2: partial problem/task overlap with a different central workflow
reference_relevance_scale.3: strong central problem or task match despite contextual differences
reference_relevance_scale.4: direct core problem/task and aligned context match

adjudication: All score disagreements require explicit evidence-based adjudication; repeated AI review is not human Gold
empty_reference_rule: Report reference perspectives with no judged positives separately. Compute answerable-perspective coverage with an explicit denominator; never invent positives to make a reference answerable.
strategy_reference_rule: Derive strategy reference sets after relevant cases are fixed from independently reviewed case strategy labels. This is a dependent AI-Silver reference, not independent human strategy Gold.

splits.existing_queries: all 10 existing questions are Dev only
splits.new_test_queries: independently authored after this protocol is pinned; no copied/paraphrased Dev query, no model rankings in construction
splits.candidate_corpus: shared retrieval corpus across query splits, as in an IR benchmark; does not claim unseen-organization generalization
splits.organization_and_source_groups: keep linked workflows together for case-group cross-validation and cluster-aware association analysis

heldout_use.before_inference: seal Test input and qrels hashes and pin the exact compared model/prompt artifacts
heldout_use.after_inference: no model/prompt/threshold/label changes based on Test results; any correction creates a new documented version
heldout_use.full_fame_ax: Test use for a later full FAME-AX variant requires its own frozen artifact manifest before first Test inference

outcomes: Vendor/agency reported, anticipated, unknown and independently measured outcomes remain distinct. Retrieval suitability does not require a numeric outcome.
wald: Association only; report small cells and separation. Unapproved or abstained labels do not become confirmatory associations.
